cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je poukázat na jiný než produkční význam ovocné dřeviny. Posluchači budou seznámeni s rozmanitými biologickými i morfologickými vlastnostmi a znaky u ovocných druhů napříč klimatickými pásmy, tomu odpovídajícími různými cestami uplatnění (zimní zahrady, oranžérie, nádobové pěstování a přirozené prostředí) vhodných ovocných druhů, stejně jako se základními principy dormance, přirychlováním květů, úchovou, významem i využitím plodů.

Distribution of fruit species according to biological and botanical properties. Content composition and importance of fruits of temperate, subtropical and tropical zones, specifics of content composition. (allowance 0/0)
World production, importance and use of fruit. Allergenic substances and plant poisons. (allowance 0/0)
Centers of origin and ecological demands of fruit species. (allowance 0/0)
Initiation and differentiation of flower buds, physiological outline. (allowance 0/0)
Dormancy of fruit trees and its role in terms of accelerating shoots (allowance 0/0)
Basics of morphology of the above-ground system of fruit trees with emphasis on the importance of ornamental function. (allowance 0/0)
The process of accelerating the flowers of fruit species; the importance of plant regulators; commercial production of rapid representatives of the genus Prunus in the world. (allowance 0/0)
The genus Prunus and the possibilities of its application in ornamental horticulture and floristic creation; other fruit species of importance for floristic production. (allowance 0/0)
Taxonomic distribution of fruit species, focus on ornamental properties and requirements of individual botanical species or varieties - part I (allowance 0/0)
Taxonomic distribution of fruit species, focus on ornamental properties and requirements of individual botanical species or varieties - part II (allowance 0/0)
Taxonomic distribution of fruit species, focus on ornamental properties and requirements of individual botanical species or varieties - part III (allowance 0/0)

Fruit species of semi subtropical and subtropical climate zone suitable for growing in cold interiors and containers; Orangeries and cold greenhouses; demands on the environment, importance and use. (allowance 0/0)
tropical fruits and delicacies species with ornamental use in interiors; tropical fruits with significance for floristic creation. (allowance 0/0)

The topics of the content of the exercise correlate with the theory of lectures, students will get acquainted with the morphology of the above-ground parts of fruit trees, the division of fertile formations of fruit trees, the pruning of fruit species, and cultivation systems. (allowance 0/0)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim is to highlight the importance of production other than fruit trees. Students will be acquainted with a variety of biological and morphological characteristics and traits of fruit species across climatic zones, corresponding to different ways of application (conservatories, orangeries, container cultivation and natural environment) of suitable fruit species, as well as basic principles of dormancy, flower acceleration, conservation. , the importance and use of fruits.
